steps.message: Distances and embedding ready: 256 taxa, 349 codons

gallery.description: Mammalian Rhodopsin visual pigments (deep-sea diving sensory adaptation).

warnings.message: 1.1% of characters are not A/C/G/T (6008 gaps, 2461 ambiguity or other codes).
55 identical sequence(s) collapsed onto 38 kept taxa (710 -> 655).
655 unique taxa exceed the cap of 256; Faith's PD subsampling keeps 256 after a stride pre-selection to 512 (dataset.py:669-685).

Deep tree (median patristic distance 0.627) with 256 taxa: neutral simulations in this regime gave a false-positive rate near 36% at 100 taxa (PLAN.md §2); treat site calls as a ranking, not as calibrated p-values.
349 codons x 256 taxa: about 5 s of model time on a laptop CPU (reference path).

data.assumption: single L*N^2 term calibrated on HIV1_RT under CPU torch fp32 (PLAN.md section 1); browser WASM to be recalibrated
